name: Balyana
sourceReview: The Egyptian General Survey Authority is evidenced as the national surveying/cadastral custodian, but its public pages provide service/procedure information rather than an anonymous Balyana parcel endpoint. The official IDSC GIS ArcGIS server was inspected and only an administrative `Egy` polygon layer was usable at the WUP point.

queryReview.englishDiscovery: Completed; ESA and official IDSC GIS sources found, no public Balyana parcel service verified.
queryReview.localLanguageDiscovery: Completed in Arabic; ESA cadastral/digital-map pages and a government survey-statement service were found, but no public parcel endpoint.
queryReview.geometry: Administrative polygon only; no parcel geometry requested or retained

requestOutcomes: ESA home and digital-map pages returned HTTP 200. IDSC ArcGIS service inventory, service metadata, layer schema, and exact-point query returned HTTP 200. The HTML ArcGIS directory returned HTTP 403 because the administrator disabled it. No login, credentials, private token, CAPTCHA bypass, or unsafe field request was used.
scopeLimits: The returned ID 20 belongs to a broad administrative layer and cannot be treated as a parcel identity.
ESA service pages describe formal/manual digital-map procurement and do not prove anonymous map/API coverage for Balyana.
No owner, address, contact, titleholder, personal, tax, account, legal-description, or value fields were requested or retained.
A point hit, map extent, directory restriction, or lack of public endpoint is not evidence of citywide parcel absence.
Runtime readiness remains held pending independent serial adapter review.
uncertainty: No claim is made about parcel absence, local registry status beyond the evidence above, legal title, ownership, tax records, or completeness of any Egyptian cadastral dataset.
